Quick actions

New uploads can be recorded by filename and date. Browser storage is temporary/session-based unless you download or connect a persistent backend.

Deployment checklist

  • Choose a project folder or HTML file.
  • Preview the selected index.html.
  • Download a deployment package or publish through a hosting provider.
  • Save the returned public URL in your deployment records.

Chat workspace

Local demonstration chat. Messages stay in this browser session and are not delivered to another person.

Welcome to Adegan Global Enterprise chat.

International SMS

Choose a dialing code and enter the recipient's number.

Actual SMS sending requires an SMS gateway (for example, a provider API) connected through a protected server. The button opens your device's SMS app; it does not silently send.

Email composer

Email opens your configured mail application using a mailto link. Reliable automated delivery requires a mail provider and secure backend.

File manager & ZIP tools

Select individual files or a folder. The dashboard records names, sizes and upload dates in this session.

Choose files or a complete folder

Maximum intended upload size: 5 GB per upload. Actual browser, device and hosting limits may be lower.

ZIP creation/extraction uses JSZip from a public CDN and requires internet access. Very large archives, especially near 5 GB, should be processed by a server-side streaming service to avoid browser memory limits.

New browser deployment

Select an index.html from your uploaded files or choose one directly.

Preview creates a temporary local browser URL. To create a permanent public URL, upload the file to a hosting provider or connect a deployment API. This page cannot publish to the internet by itself.

C++ / source-code editor

Edit text-based source files locally. This editor does not compile C++ in the browser.

To compile and run C++, use a local compiler or a connected build server. Never put private API keys or passwords in this public HTML file.

Network availability
